link.note: Named as Pietro's mother ('the late Lucia Marra') in his 1901 death act and as Gaetana's mother in the 1855 marriage index.

summary: John's maternal 4th great-grandmother, of Guardia Lombardi.
bio: Wife of Angelo Petriello; dead by 29 Mar 1901. Note: another Guardia couple, Carmine Petriello and Maria Marra, were parents of Giuseppe Petriello who married Concetta di Marino in 1855 - Marra and Petriello intermarried; relationship to Lucia unknown. Petriello, Marra, Di Marino and De Biasi act as witnesses for one another in Guardia records.
